verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap publishes a versioning and deprecation policy covering the Jobs, x402, and Edge APIs. Versions sit in the URL path (/v2/), releases follow SemVer, and breaking changes ship as a new path version. Removal of any API version gets at least six months' notice. Per-API changelogs exist, and the v2 Jobs changelog entries confirm this in practice. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that deprecation notices are actually honored.
